0022600194.text: The Houston Rockets, 7-2 and first in the Southwest, bring a 3-1 road record into their 10th game of the season after a loss in their most recent game, and Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain) are both out. The Phoenix Suns are 1-5 and 12th in the West, have lost four straight, and will be without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 119-105 win in Phoenix on April 7, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
